deterministic_prior.scope: All actors inherit the deterministic dynamics program; only H2/MC4 references use the frozen source spawn router. Source acquisition/router costs are retained separately; old trees, selectors and outer games are not used.

inherited_work.scope: V120 training, model setup and all saved checkpoints retained separately; V120 evaluations, H2/MC4 decisions and outer outcomes are not inputs.
